doc.title: Buddy DeFranco interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks DeFranco on behalf of Hamilton College.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has really been fascinating talking with you.
And as our leading exponent of the jazz clarinet, I hope that you keep it up forever.
Thank you. I’m going to try because I think I’m improving.
Well on behalf of Hamilton College I’d like to thank Buddy DeFranco so much for joining us today. I wish you a good concert tonight.
